To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the UTAUT model has been found to be applicable for mobile wallet adoption and that the two trust variables namely trust in mobile wallet services (TMS) and trust in mobile services providers (TMSP) have a significant impact on the adoption.
trust in mobile wallet services is a significant factor in adoption of mobile wallets by Indian consumers.

Indian consumers are willing to adopt mobile wallets and their adoption is influenced by the trust that they have in the services provided by the mobile wallets as well as the trust in the service providers.

understanding how the adoption of mobile wallets can be explained by the UTAUT model.
identifying the factors that influence the Indian consumers to accept mobile wallet as a mode of payment.
the adoption of mobile wallets by consumers and its factors.

the UTAUT model is a good framework for understanding the adoption of mobile wallet services by Indian consumers.
the Indian consumers are willing to adopt mobile wallets but there are few factors that are inhibiting their adoption.
